I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is for 382 seats."

I also saved the figure to my memory, along with where it came from: Tobias, #central-team, 2026-10-14. That way I can find it again in later sessions. A seat count counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so I can share it with anyone on the account's team or in an org-wide role. As Tobias asked, I took no other action.
